text: I heard her tell the driver Charing Cross and to look sharp.” Tommy stared at him, his eyes opening wide in surprise. Emboldened, the small boy proceeded. “So I thought, having asked for an A.B.C. and a Bradshaw.” Tommy interrupted him: “When did she ask for an A.B.C. and a Bradshaw?” “When I took her the telegram, sir.” “A telegram?” “Yes, sir.” “When was that?” “About half-past twelve, sir.” “Tell me exactly what happened.” The small boy drew a long breath.
